Sakai et al. (2014) Fe0.9Ni0.1 hcp alloy. Mixed Fe/Ni occupancy on the hcp 2c site. Reference lattice is the observed F10N06\_012 cell at 27.1 GPa, 300 K, not an ambient cell.

## Automatic selections

- **Equilibrium:** [fe09ni01\_hcp\_sakai\_2014\_p1\_bm3](#record-fe09ni01_hcp_sakai_2014_p1_bm3)
- **Hugoniot:** None
